landscape.label: 2026 Price Guide
title: Bathroom Remodel
Pricing Guide
landscape.say: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Westlake Village in 2026? Here's the pricing guide: three price tiers, what each type of bathroom costs, what moves your budget, and the permits and HOA rules to plan for.

landscape.label: 2026 Price Tiers
landscape.title: What a Westlake Village bathroom costs
landscape.sub: 2026 ranges · depending on size and scope
landscape.speak: In Westlake Village, a basic bathroom update runs about five thousand two hundred fifty dollars to fifteen thousand seven hundred fifty dollars. A mid-range remodel runs fifteen thousand seven hundred fifty dollars to twenty-six thousand two hundred fifty dollars. And a high-end remodel starts around thirty-one thousand five hundred dollars and goes up from there.
landscape.say: In Westlake Village, a basic bathroom update runs about $5,250 to $15,750. A mid-range remodel runs $15,750 to $26,250. And a high-end remodel starts around $31,500 and goes up from there.

landscape.label: Tier 1 of 3
landscape.name: Basic bathroom update
landscape.desc: Ideal for small hall baths and powder rooms.

bullets.t: No major layout or plumbing changes

landscape.speak: A basic bathroom update, at five thousand two hundred fifty dollars to fifteen thousand seven hundred fifty dollars, is ideal for small hall baths and powder rooms: a new vanity, toilet, faucet, and light fixtures, with simple tile or vinyl flooring, and no major layout or plumbing changes.
landscape.say: A basic bathroom update, at $5,250 to $15,750, is ideal for small hall baths and powder rooms: a new vanity, toilet, faucet, and light fixtures, with simple tile or vinyl flooring, and no major layout or plumbing changes.

landscape.label: Tier 2 of 3
landscape.name: Mid-range remodel
landscape.desc: The most common Westlake Village bathroom project.

bullets.t: Convert a tub to a shower

landscape.speak: A mid-range remodel, fifteen thousand seven hundred fifty dollars to twenty-six thousand two hundred fifty dollars, can convert a tub to a shower, with new tile throughout, an upgraded vanity with a stone countertop, new lighting, mirror, and plumbing updates, and minor layout changes.
landscape.say: A mid-range remodel, $15,750 to $26,250, can convert a tub to a shower, with new tile throughout, an upgraded vanity with a stone countertop, new lighting, mirror, and plumbing updates, and minor layout changes.

landscape.label: Tier 3 of 3
landscape.name: High-end remodel
landscape.desc: A full master bathroom, finished like a private retreat.

bullets.t: Custom walk-in shower or freestanding tub

landscape.speak: A high-end remodel starts around thirty-one thousand five hundred dollars. That's a full master bathroom: a custom walk-in shower or freestanding tub, a double vanity with premium materials, built-in storage and high-end finishes, a layout redesign, and radiant heated floors.
landscape.say: A high-end remodel starts around $31,500. That's a full master bathroom: a custom walk-in shower or freestanding tub, a double vanity with premium materials, built-in storage and high-end finishes, a layout redesign, and radiant heated floors.

landscape.label: Cost by Room
landscape.title: Cost by type of bathroom
landscape.sub: Powder room vs. hall bath vs. master
landscape.speak: By type of bathroom: a powder room runs about five thousand two hundred fifty dollars to twelve thousand six hundred dollars. A hall bathroom, the most common remodel, runs fifteen thousand seven hundred fifty dollars to twenty-six thousand two hundred fifty dollars. And a master bathroom runs twenty-six thousand two hundred fifty dollars to fifty-two thousand five hundred dollars and up, with walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, and luxury finishes.
landscape.say: By type of bathroom: a powder room runs about $5,250 to $12,600. A hall bathroom, the most common remodel, runs $15,750 to $26,250. And a master bathroom runs $26,250 to $52,500 and up, with walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, and luxury finishes.

landscape.speak: A few Westlake Village notes. Budget roughly five hundred twenty-five dollars to twenty-one hundred dollars for permits, since fees scale with your project's value. Westlake Village has twenty neighborhoods with active HOAs. Interior remodels usually don't need HOA approval, but structural or exterior changes may.
